sections.label: Assessment and therapy, built around your child
text: Assessment and therapy, built around your child
Every child is different, so we don't offer one-size-fits-all packages. We build a plan around what your child needs, and what's realistic for your family and school.
OT Assessments
Comprehensive assessments covering sensory processing, motor skills, self-care, emotional regulation and school participation, with a clear written report and practical recommendations.
1:1 Therapy Programmes
Ongoing therapy blocks tailored to your child's goals — from handwriting and fine motor skills to sensory regulation, using play-based, evidence-informed approaches.
School Consultation
We work directly with class teachers and SENCOs, observing children in the classroom and co-designing strategies that fit into the real school day.
Parent & Carer Coaching
Practical, judgement-free guidance for the people who know your child best — helping you understand behaviour, adapt routines, and feel confident supporting them at home.
EHCP & SEND Reports
Independent OT reports to support Education, Health and Care Plan applications, tribunals, and annual reviews, written in clear, accessible language.
Sensory Circuits & Groups
Small-group sensory and motor skills sessions designed for schools and nurseries, plus staff training so strategies continue between our visits.

sections.label: What working with us looks like
text: What working with us looks like
A straightforward, transparent process from first enquiry to ongoing support.
Free initial call
A 15-minute conversation to understand your concerns and check we're the right fit.
Assessment
In-depth assessment at home, school or our clinic, using standardised tools and observation.
Report & recommendations
A clear report with practical strategies for home and school, talked through with you.
Ongoing therapy
If needed, a therapy plan with regular reviews so we can track progress and adjust goals.

sections.label: Who we work with
text: Who we work with
We collaborate with everyone in a child's world, not just the child in the therapy room.
Families
Parents and carers looking for answers, strategies, and a therapist who explains things clearly — no jargon, no judgement.
Schools & Nurseries
SENCOs and teaching staff wanting hands-on classroom support, staff training, and reports that are actually usable.
Other Professionals
Paediatricians, speech and language therapists, and educational psychologists we liaise with to provide joined-up care.

sections.label: Frequently asked questions
text: Frequently asked questions
Answers to the questions we're asked most often.
Do we need a referral to book an assessment?
No. Most of our families self-refer, though we're happy to liaise with your GP, paediatrician, or school if that's helpful.
Which areas do you cover?
We offer home and school visits across most of England and Wales, and video consultations for families further afield. Get in touch and we'll confirm availability in your area.
How long does an assessment take?
A full OT assessment typically takes 1.5–2 hours, plus time to review information from parents and school. Your written report usually follows within two to three weeks.
Can Sensphere reports be used for EHCP applications?
Yes. Our reports are written to a standard suitable for EHCP needs assessments, annual reviews, and tribunal evidence, and we're experienced in supporting families through this process.
Do you offer sessions in schools during the school day?
Yes, this is one of our most requested services. We work with schools to schedule visits, group sessions, and staff training with minimal disruption to the timetable.
